method.cuts_scales_geometry_encoder: Unchanged; exact pins are in METHOD_FREEZE.json.
method.guard: TCP SYN=1 and ACK=0 keeps RAW for every target.

target.role: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B edge/Mosquitto server

reference.description: Early trusted normal within the same capture; not cross-year historical validation.
reference.selection: Frozen dense commissioning rule on all legal target endpoints in the complete unfiltered prefix; preserve distinct-component eligibility and RAW fallback.

capture_boundaries.rule: Split original NORMAL record ranges at positive capture-order gaps >3600s; do not shift clocks, sort regressions or join segments.
capture_boundaries.context: Reset RECENT context at each logical-capture boundary; preserve original raw SHA/frame lineage and pin any logical-frame mapping.
capture_boundaries.bank: One earliest completed static bank remains causally available for later captures; never rebuild it using their normal queries.
capture_boundaries.gap_independence_scope: Independent context/reporting segments, not independent devices or newly onboarded reference budgets.
capture_boundaries.December_segment: Later normal queries only, not pre-attack reference. It need not independently supply a fresh 7200s bank.
capture_boundaries.capture_duration_caution: First two >1h-gap segments exceed the paper stated 3h capture maximum; these are observed time segments, not verified independent recording sessions.

context_and_population_gate.same_namespace_regression: Keep frozen permanent poison semantics; do not repair the clock or reorder.
context_and_population_gate.cross_key_capture_regression: Record under frozen Contexts; not automatically equivalent to a poisoned namespace.
context_and_population_gate.invalid_or_unsupported_rows: Count by reason before scores and seal population/UIDs; do not turn unscored rows into correct negatives or silently drop required truth.

labels.evidence_level: Researcher-reconstructed attack-associated direct direction, supported by official scenario/tool descriptions and observed traffic; not official packet payload ground truth.
labels.normal: Official Normal traffic/Temperature_and_Humidity file, target-owned legal TCP/UDP; other-protocol context is outside evaluated protocol scope.

HTTP.predicate: origin=HTTP AND IPv4.src=192.168.0.170 AND IPv4.dst=192.168.0.128 AND eth.dst=dc:a6:32:fb:69:b5 AND IP.proto=6 AND TCP.dport=80 AND original timestamp in the pinned capture interval
HTTP.flags_for_all_direct: All observed TCP flags remain in direct session population; do not infer maliciousness from flags alone.
HTTP.ACK_control_semantics: ACK/FIN/handshake are attack-session control traffic, not independent ACK floods; GET starts (19076 observed) and payload-containing packets are reported separately.

UDP.predicate: origin=UDP AND IPv4.dst=192.168.0.128 AND eth.dst=dc:a6:32:fb:69:b5 AND IP.proto=17 AND UDP.dport=0 AND original timestamp in the pinned capture interval
UDP.source_policy: No four-IP whitelist: the authors describe source spoofing; do not pretend random source IPs are independent attackers.
UDP.port_zero: Observed header value; preserve frozen legal endpoint range 0..65535.

labels.outside_attack_direction: Retain for full unfiltered context and separate audit; exclude from normal/attack scored truth and every reference bank.
labels.public_HTTP_counterpart: 216.58.198.74:80 exchanges with target local port42162 are background-role traffic, not attacker->target:80.
labels.publication_claim: Direct attack-associated packet recall, with control/GET/payload strata; not detection probability of independent attacks.

difficulty_descriptive_only.interpretation: Service/traffic-distribution shift, not absent UDP protocol; ports are component metadata rather than direct numeric RECENT header-token features. Do not predict detector success from this.

metrics_draft.primary: Same-population per-packet ensemble FPR, recall, FP/FN and counts; all four heads and each segment/scenario/flags stratum also reported.
metrics_draft.full_causal_rule: Before bank closure keep RAW; after closure use only the fixed completed bank.
metrics_draft.weight_allocation: Equal child mass at each level; normalize normal and attack separately. These are external weights, not A/B-identical metrics.
metrics_draft.event_report: Two scenario capture groups; exact number of repeated official events unknown. No invented UNKNOWN event pass or claim millions of independent attacks.
metrics_draft.safety: Cumulative TP withdrawals relative to RAW, device<=1pp and available scenario<=5pp, low-RAW-recall group zero TP withdrawal; retain frozen four-head safety logic, mark missing truth NOT_EVALUABLE.
metrics_draft.uncertainty: No naive binomial/Wilson CI on weighted or correlated packets. Show counts and per-day/scenario limits; cluster scheme must be sealed before scores.

methods.strong_baseline: Must be selected, implemented and source-calibrated under the same normal-information/time budget before external scores; not ready.

resources.population_sampling: No subsampling authorized/fixed here; any feasibility sampling must be specified before scores and the card resealed.

required_before_execution: Implement isolated external adapter without changing numeric core and verify source parity
Seal external metrics, uncertainty scheme, query population and baselines
Fill resource/runtime bounds and pass same-delivery real-slice E2E
outcome_policy: Report failures; no external-output-driven p/lambda/cut/radius/bank/salt adjustment or dataset selection.
